items.title: Ambassador Mignano on a mission to Sudan, the first Italian ambassador in Khartoum since 2023
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 25 AGO - The new ambassador to Sudan, Silvio Mignano—who had been based in Addis Ababa since the start of the conflict—carried out his first mission in the country. The mission included a stop in Port Sudan before moving on to Khartoum for the presentation of credentials. This was the embassy’s first mission to the capital since the evacuation in 2023. Italy is the first Western country to present its credentials. The Sudanese capital had been occupied in 2023 by paramilitaries of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), but since May 2025, it has returned to the control of the army
items.titleIt: Ambassador Mignano on a mission to Sudan, the first Italian ambassador in Khartoum since 2023

items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. items.title: Sudan: Sudanese UN Envoy - Eastern Libya, Chad and Ethiopia Are Supply Routes for RSF Militia
items.description: [SNA] Sudan's Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Ambassador Al-Harith Idris, said in a briefing to the UN Security Council on Monday that the UN Panel of Experts had documented the transformation of eastern Libya into a central hub in the supply chain of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), with the renovation and expansion of Kufra Airport and a significant increase in cargo flights coinciding with the growth of the RSF's capabilities.

items.title: Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio resigns from all positions at EssilorLuxottica
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 25 - Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio is resigning from all positions he held at EssilorLuxottica to focus on new business projects, spokesperson for the Italian-French group said Tuesday, confirming a media report. "We thank Leonardo Maria for contributing to the group's growth and the realization of his father's strategic vision. We wish him the same success in his new venture," the Essilux spokesperson added after the 'Milano-Finanza' preview. Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio stepped down as president of Ray-Ban and chief strategy officer of the Italian-French giant in a letter to Fr
items.titleIt: Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio resigns from all positions at EssilorLuxottica

"I see no conflict between Germany and Italy," said Stefan Kornelius, spokesman, in response to a question during a government press conference regarding the ongoing exchange between the two countries on the case of the deportations of the so-called 'Dubliners', announced in recent days by Berlin. items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 25 - Italian police on Tuesday cited five teenage far-right extremists for online radicalisation and using neo-Nazi and white supremacist slogans online in the south Tuscan city of Arezzo.
